data.narrative:
Phoenix Tailings is a Series B climate and energy company founded by Nick Myers, Tomás Villalón, and Anthony Balladon that has raised $117.8M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of three private peers in the same sector at the same or adjacent stage: KoBold Metals ($3.0B, Series C), Electric Hydrogen ($1.0B, Series C), and Amogy ($700M, Series C), alongside public comps including Redwood Materials and QuantumScape.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-Progression analysis applies a 1.9x multiplier to the $118M total capital raised proxy, yielding $224M. This reflects typical valuation step-ups from Series B to the subsequent funding round. Peer-Median analysis benchmarks against the three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables, which exhibit a median valuation of $1.0B and a range of $700M to $3.0B.

These methods produce a triangulated range of $190M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median implied valuation of $612M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around stage-specific revenue or technical progress metrics not present in this dataset, as well as heterogeneous exit trajectories and capital efficiency among peer companies. Stage-Progression offers a floor anchored to deployment capital; Peer-Median incorporates market pricing of adjacent players but with limited visibility into Phoenix Tailings' relative technical or commercial position.
